verdict.rationale: Canny documents a hosted, customer-facing feedback site/Portal, and the only setup step shown is adding a link to it, which suggests a product manager could launch it without code. However, no evidence describes a no-code admin setup flow. User identification requires installing a JavaScript SDK, which implies engineering work. The "no engineering" claim applies only to the MCP server, a different story. Missing for 10: documented self-serve portal setup and configuration by non-technical users, evidence that the portal can be branded or customized without engineering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can set up a public-facing feedback portal without engineering help
